exposure: Primiparous women cared for by private midwives vs. national data
Women cared for by private midwives vs. national data
outcome: Need for specialist consultation or referral
Presence of primary midwife at birth
Place of birth (home vs. birth center)
cohort: Women who received care from the largest private midwifery service in Australia between 2014 and 2022 (n=2747)
finding: Compared to national data, women cared for by private midwives had significantly lower rates of interventions during labor and delivery, and their babies were more likely to be exclusively breastfed at six weeks.
mod_finding: Women cared for by private midwives had significantly lower rates of inductions, cesarean sections, instrumental vaginal births, and episiotomies compared to national data.
